\section{Profile}
PhD researcher in corporate governance and technology management, with expertise in machine learning, survival analysis, and panel data econometrics. Doctoral research investigates the timing and dynamics of Chief Technology Officer appointments, contributing to upper echelons theory and strategic leadership literature. Published in the \textit{International Journal of Finance \& Economics} (SSCI, ABS 3-star) with four additional working papers targeting top-tier journals. Eight years of professional experience in financial policy analysis at the People's Bank of China. Seeking a research-focused academic position in business and management.
